This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER 1.

This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 9.12.2023 in connection with Crime No. 723/2023, registered at Police Station Kotwali District Tikamgarh for the offence punishable under Sections 305, 376 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that one young girl committed suicide by jumping in a well.
In merg statement which was recorded, no allegations were made against the applicant.
Statements were recorded 2-3 times.
It was only in the month of December that one Sitaram who is related to deceased gave statement that applicant was seen sitting along with the deceased.
It is submitted that in postmortem report sperm was found in vaginal swab and after that offence of rape has been registered against the applicant.
It is submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on Rahul @ Krishna Lodhi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21220733/
1 bail.
3 .

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.
It is submitted by him as per call details applicant was talking to the deceased and he also relied on confession of applicant made before the police.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
There is a long delay in making allegations against the applicant.
No evidence except phone call details is available against the applicant.
Applicant is a young boy of 20 years of age.
Prosecutrix at the time of commission of offence was aged about 17 years and 3 months.
6 . Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of R s . 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousands only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

8. In addition to that the applicant shall also abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437 (3)
of Cr. P. C..
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
